Al cierre de octubre, nuestra lectura fa: At October’s close, our reading favours selecting projects for their ability to generate and preserve cash under stress. El 8 de octubre, la OMC elevó su previsi: On 8 October, the WTO raised its 2026 merchandise trade volume growth forecast to 3.9%, from 1.9% in March, and reduced its services forecast to 3.3%, from 4.8%. The improvement is uneven and receives a significant boost from AI-related goods.
